subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should enabled per-response `/usage` footers show a lifecycle-owned cached active-provider quota summary, and if so which modes and refresh/omission rules are part of the public contract?
rationale: Current documentation and prior unmerged implementations show that the missing behavior is real, but they do not settle whether quota data may be fetched during reply completion or must be prepared elsewhere, nor whether it belongs in `tokens`, `full`, or both.

options.title: Add cached quota summaries to full mode
options.body: Extend only `/usage full` with an optional prepared provider-quota summary, refreshed outside the reply hot path and omitted when unavailable.

options.title: Add it to tokens and full
options.body: Show the same prepared quota summary for both enabled footer modes, accepting a denser `tokens` footer contract.

options.title: Keep quota in status views
options.body: Retain the current separation and decline per-response provider quota display to avoid another footer data lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Add cached quota summaries to full mode
recommendation.body: Extend only `/usage full` with an optional prepared provider-quota summary, refreshed outside the reply hot path and omitted when unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history covers provider usage, status display, and the prior maintainer scoping discussion for this exact integration.
